parts.text: Andy works in the pro shop of a tennis resort.
He has 120 racquets that need restringing.
30 of them are to be strung with synthetic gut, 50 of them will be strung with polyester string, and 40 of them will be strung with a hybrid set (half synthetic gut, half polyester string).

How long will it take Andy to string all of those racquets if it takes him an average of 150 minutes for him to string with synthetic gut, 220 minutes to string with polyester string, and 180 minutes for hybrid sets?
